features.feature: - Add pure mounted process-manager discovery through `pm types` and `GET /pm/types`, with bounded on-demand HTTP encoding and no store reads.

- Compose allocated inspection applications under stable `/keiro`, `/kiroku`, `/shibuya` and `/pgmq` prefixes with preserved raw paths, shared CORS policy and a flag-guarded example using released Kiroku metrics.

features.feature: - Add shared `/ws` first-page feeds for workflow, timer and projection status, backed by the same bounded reads and encoders as polls. Drivers share the HTTP budget; idle handles own no wake cursor. Count/byte-bounded queues, in-flight accounting, overflow recovery, upgrade policy checks and scoped cleanup protect runtime resources. The standalone HTTP server mounts feeds.

- Add bounded projection-status pages and `projection status`, preserving the frozen v1 relation and complete-list compatibility API. Page keys precede correlated status reads; no writer index is added. HTTP feed protocol and canonical view definitions are available as foundations for live feeds.

- Add process-manager persisted-state inspection and bounded raw stream listing, pending-timer pages with filter-bound cursors, and database-clock shard ownership/listing. Reads add no worker queries, polling tasks or migrations. Embedded `pm show/list` uses the additive `AppHooks.processManagers` field; `emptyAppHooks` leaves this optional catalog off.

- Explicit, bounded legacy manager provenance through `RunCommandOptions.inspectionProvenance` (default `NoInspectionProvenance`). Capture records intended source/target evidence under `keiro.pm`, capped at 64 targets, 64 timer ids and 16 KiB, with an explicit truncation marker. Existing updates of defaultRunCommandOptions remain disabled.
- Application-owned aggregate inspection catalogs, source-reporting hydration, bounded aggregate pages and embedded read-only ops commands.
- Add bounded workflow pages and `wf inspect`, canonical status classes, and the shared cursor codec.
- Add `keiro-ops-http`, an opt-in HTTP transport with bounded inspection, per-request schema verification, and preview/confirm mutations.

- `reactiveProcessManagerInspector` mounts reaction state, live input candidates and timers through the existing `pm show/list` commands. Modern reaction provenance is explicitly unavailable; `legacy-positional-v1` capture remains positional-only and that legacy API retires with Languages 1–5 before 1.0.

- `wf list/show` JSON adds `status_class`; `wf steps` entries add `recorded_at`. `wf show` orders awakeables by `(created_at, awakeable_id)` and children by `(created_at, child_id, child_name)` from their owning tables.
- `shard status` adds `observed_at`, `heartbeat_at`, `updated_at` and `lease_age_seconds` from database-clock observations.
features.rationale: Corrected provisional owner: this is selected administrative/HTTP inspection rather than a native delivery contract. Remains pending until106 executes it.

features.feature: - Fail oversized workflow continuations explicitly instead of returning a cursor that the next request cannot decode.

Legacy listing and creation-order cursors retain their contracts. Sparse/absent filters and creation sorting still require host deadlines and measured cadence.

HTTP, CORS and sockets share normalized scheme/host/effective-port comparisons; TLS proxies explicitly allow-list the public HTTPS origin.

- Delivery expiry terminates an incomplete response and returns shared admission without a second response. Health recovers after cancellation. Feeds retain fresh schema checks and clock-bearing snapshots; retiring views return `view_retiring` until cleanup joins.
features.rationale: Corrected provisional owner: this is selected administrative/HTTP inspection rather than a native delivery contract. Remains pending until106 executes it.

features.feature: - Candidate Language 6 supports complete mapped-register `initial` and `mapped(expression)` writes under generated guard/slot ownership, backed by one pure, total, versioned declaration-owned scalar `write-lift` and finite cases. Recursive projected/predicate inputs and mixed Hole ownership remain refused. Used-lift provenance enters fold/snapshot identity; own-revision replay comparison handles lift removal/source replacement. Unused lifts and cases-only edits are replay-neutral build advisories. Schema-1 mapping ledgers remain readable. A compiled lifecycle service and restoring mutation proof run in `just verify`.
